## Ordered engineering build refresh

Parent #344, M7.P5. Owner direction: “You have my approval to do the cleanup, and you have my approval to generate the H700 build. Following the H700 build, we should try the SM8550 build.” Current direction: “Let's fix any caps we discover before we generate a new build.” The owner clarified “any gaps”.

The prior #492 H70002/SM855003 images and consumed device deployments remain accepted for their older source. Replacement20 is now clean/retained VM-qualified at1a026648442321609b2288c2c9c06803817f9df2; #553/#554 review and all four repairs are complete. Freeze published next after exact-head CI. Compare all product inputs with that qualified VM; the only current difference is a byte-identical patch-payload header clarification. Build H700, accept its artifacts, then build and accept SM8550. Retain every original failure/result.

Can this be done on the VM? Shared behavior has already been qualified on the exact GENERIC_X64 image with clean/retained/protocol/frame evidence. Host cross-compilation and raw/update payload inspection qualify target packaging and source identity. Actual SoC boot, radio, audio, battery and panel behavior need later named physical actions; no owner device/cloud action occurs in this issue. No public RC or publication approval.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Published source/pins/container/options/source inventory, qualified-VM product comparison, current capacity/RAM/swap and isolated cache provenance are frozen; full checks and source-bound manifests PASS. Evidence: publishedfreeze47ce541e6a and `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-device-refresh/h70003/cache-consumption.json`; allcopychannels0/actualownersgone, preflightREADY, container-runtime gatePASS.
- [x] H700 canonical ARM→aarch64 build completes with all original result channels0 and actual owner/container exited; watcher receipt and final source/output manifests are retained.
- [x] H700 independent raw/update acceptance verifies both DDR images, installed current helpers/ES/proxy/rclone/version metadata, native architecture/ARM handoff, no retired migration, exact output hashes and any bounded inherited-output differences.
- [x] After accepted H700 and refreshed resource checks, SM8550 canonical ARM→aarch64 build completes with all original result channels0 and actual owner/container exited; watcher receipt and final source/output manifests are retained.
- [x] SM8550 independent raw/update acceptance verifies GPT/ABL/FEX and ARM handoff, current helpers/ES/proxy/rclone/version metadata, exact output hashes and any bounded inherited-output differences.
- [ ] M7/#344/checkpoint link final engineering artifacts and explicit physical/publication holds; #493 retires superseded immediate-test payloads only after the last verified dependency, preserving compact evidence and required source custody.

Use independent verified warm roots; preserve stable container paths and set effective container TMPDIR=/tmp. No mutation of accepted predecessor roots and no cross-root hardlinks. Build one device at a time. Active primary supervision consumes the shared watcher; no off-session notification service is claimed.

Current evidence: Both refreshed handheld builds and independent artifact acceptance are COMPLETE, from audited bc9dfe8141 with shared identity `0.0.1-dev+20261011T222153Z.gbc9dfe8141d9`. H700 build ended0 at22:51:17UTC and acceptance04 at22:54:47UTC; both DDR variants/update and186 ARM files pass. SM8550 build05 ended0 at23:31:03UTC and acceptance05 at23:31:43UTC; raw/update equality, GPT, all five ABL package files,14 FEX outputs and188 ARM files pass. All original successful-run channels0, actual owners exited, containers removed and acceptance scratch removed. Box86 differences are bounded date/time/revision metadata only; added popt is exact from package staging through ARM and installed firmware. H700 bundle66273ff16383957687af44728a9e4e2c4bf1242c0217cf681dca8abee858d9b7; SM8550 bundlea480210cd8837f20fb67a80508c517308cc0326ed2c1544493e3f56d125f1f2f. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-device-refresh/`.

#493 remains the next host task: classify superseded roots/firmware and source-custody dependencies, prepare guarded retirement, then remeasure capacity. Current host availability is647,420,825,600bytes (about603GiB). No old deletion batch is replayed or widened. Current H700 supports owner testing; current SM8550 is held for its next named physical test. Large historical artifacts are not permanent fallbacks. Physical/publication holds stay explicit; no public RC is allocated.

The final combined tracking/retirement checkbox remains open for #493 retirement completion; firmware build and artifact qualification are complete.
